review:
Candy Jar Clusters is a cluster game where six or more adjacent sweets are needed for a win, one more than many cluster slots. Cakes, jellies and doughnuts are the top symbols, wilds substitute for everything in the base game, and winning symbols cascade away.

At random during any spin, a multiplier up to 100x can be applied to all wins and tumbles. Candy symbols in winning clusters are collected in feature jars, and when a jar fills, it can trigger free spins with wild multipliers, retriggers, or one of five jackpots. Each bonus can award up to 14 free spins. The advertised maximum is 10,000x and the RTP is 96.08%. The jar system gives you a visible goal during the base game.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
